author: Stokesy719
body:
First off, I in no way expected an appeal. It's interesting considering you are a high position yet you did not know until now that I ban evade considering half your staff team does.  Anyways, that's not important. 
I asked for evidence of me cheating, not a clip of 3 minutes of pvp before you banned me. I have no idea whatsoever looked wrong with that, and I have consulted with a good amount of people. From these, the only thing that might remotely sketch at all is me aiming at my teammates, (which I have mentioned several time on past 10 or so false bans for hacking) that I do this to practice my aim, especially considering that clip was me pvping after a one week break off of mc. My teammate hits weren't even consistent so idk how that classifies. I wasn't even pvping well.  Not exactly sure what that skype convo is for lmao. I just messaged him since I was talking to him in game, and I said I did got banned for aimbot, not that I was using it. Pointing out that I was ban evading is useless since you do up checks, and I literally said "frequent customer" in the title, the fact that you are proving it is 100% useless. As for this being a valid ban for previously hacking, Bader himself knows that my forcefield ban was in fact false so it's pretty stupid bringing that up to validate my hacks is again quite stupid. What I have learned from this and all my false bans. 1)Staff have difficulty in hack detection and there is a higher chance of you getting falsely banned if you are not  a "regular" for the exact same pvp style   2) out of all the staff that have false banned me in the past you are the one who think I'm not (except maybe PieZ who banned an alt for triggerbot, but he doesn't know about it). 
I would really suggest that you guys impliment some sort of hack detection course, as it really seems like you guys need it. There a few staff who are knowledgable in this regard...have them train the rest you you guys. 
Thats all, it's been a good almost 3 years (and still counting) 
sincerely
zaidms0987

replies.author: Protel
replies.body:
Hello!

I do agree the evidence is a little bit short, but I was told it was triggerbot post-ban; in opposition to my previous assumptions (KA, Aimbot), which in all mediocrity I forgot the name of the cheat and morphed two things in similarity with it. 

I was not in participation with your previous ban for cheating, and had no prior knowledge of your ban-evasion. I can change the infraction to ban-evasion if that would please you more? From my speculation and evidence, it looked like you were cheating, the evidence I have been told was valid, but even besides that factor, the evasion just wraps it all up into a permanent ban in either manner.  

Sincerely, 
Theoretical
